name: ai-tool-box
description: AI Tool Box - 集成多个主流 AI 工具的应用

scripts.test:e2e:all: cross-env E2E_IMAGE_TOOLS=all E2E_BING_MATRIX=1 E2E_GEMINI_MATRIX=1 E2E_INCLUDE_REFERENCE=1 E2E_INCLUDE_COUNT=1 E2E_INCLUDE_CONCURRENCY=1 node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/imageGenApi.e2e.test.ts
scripts.electron:dev: pnpm run electron:compile && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on -t 120000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:debug: cross-env ELECTRON_SOURCEMAP=1 pnpm run electron:compile && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_SOURCEMAP=1 concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on -t 120000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && electron --inspect=9230 ."
scripts.electron:build: pnpm run generate:icon && pnpm run build && pnpm run electron:compile && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: pnpm run generate:icon && pnpm run build && pnpm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.electron:build:mac: pnpm run generate:icon && pnpm run build && pnpm run electron:compile && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.electron:build:all: pnpm run generate:icon && pnpm run build && pnpm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win --x64 --mac --arm64
scripts.build:exe: pnpm run generate:icon && pnpm run build && pnpm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.build:portable: pnpm run generate:icon && pnpm run build && pnpm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win portable --x64
